Players Committee card image of [[Hylobon Enforcer]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy -1 and forfeit +1 at same or related location as Vos or at an opponent's site. Permanent weapon is Percussive Cannon (may target a character using 1 Force; draw destiny; if destiny +1 > defense value, target's game text is canceled for remainder of turn).” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Hylobon%20Enforcer.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Hylobon Enforcer.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
